input.title: [eval] adapter with no work
input.body:
# Adapter with no work

## Problem

Collision clusters still serialize because there is no execution-backend adapter that can fan work into parallel worktrees.

## Goals

A Cursor adapter claims a cluster, opens one worktree per item, and reports completion back to the ledger without a human babysitting the checkout.

## Non-Goals

Graphban does not become an IDE. The adapter talks to Cursor; it does not replace it.

## Acceptance criteria

Given a cluster of three ready items, three worktrees exist and each item is claimed by a distinct session.

## Adapter

Build the Cursor execution-backend adapter that maps a collision cluster onto parallel worktrees and streams claim heartbeats.
